Dear Mr. Bixby:
I have been trying for some time to get up enough courage to
write you a letter containing something more, or less, than a
mere recital of the events of the day as they take place.

and indefinite terms, as to what the outcome of the present

havent been able to reach any conclusion with sufficient clearness

About all I am really/going on is hope, a term I use with full

into the fighting forces since this war started or who has a son
who has done so. I realize there must be many of the so called
